title: GOV-0045: freeze badf-git capability contract (GTGM, DESIGNED, no Git authority) — salvage PR #122
problem:
## Observed

BADF has no `badf-git` capability — no frozen, governed contract for how Git state, branches, worktrees, staging, commits, rebases, PRs, composition, integration, recovery, tags and releases are handled for a work package. The operator's *BADF Git Cycle & Git Loop — Research + Design v0.1* recommends standardizing on the **Governed Trunk Git Model (GTGM)** — one protected `main` ledger + short-lived WP branches + one governed integration PR + deterministic composed-tree verification + squash integration + immutable release evidence + explicit recovery — as an evolution of the live repo (which already enforces squash-only, linear history, composed-tree CI via `badf_compose.py`).

An external actor opened **PR #122** attempting this exact freeze, but it is draft, **CONFLICTING**, and re-uses already-consumed identities (`BADF-DEM-0052`, `WP-2026-0064`, `WP-2026-0065` — all landed on `main`). It can never merge cleanly. **This is the #47 situation:** its contract content is valuable; its ledger state is not.

## Expected

**Salvage over repair** (the path `badf-prd`←#44 and `badf-requirements`←#47 took): build **badf-git** fresh from current `main` as a top-level **declarative** capability — a router and constraint layer, **not** a Git authority, merge bot, release authority, or second gate — porting #122's authoring content onto a clean WP.

**BADF-WP-GIT-A — contract freeze, `DESIGNED` only:** `skills/badf-git/SKILL.md` + eight reference contracts (`git-cycle`, `git-state-machine`, `branch-pr-contract`, `operation-authority-matrix`, `composition-and-staleness`, `recovery-contract`, `release-versioning`, `evidence-contract`). Invariants `GIT-I01` (no Git authority) … `GIT-I12` (no second gate/mutation engine). **No `scripts/badf_git.py`, no new schema, no Git authority** — `badf_gate.py` and the platform rules remain the sole authorities; the canonical composition mechanism remains `badf_compose.py`. Registered `DESIGNED`.

## Evidence

- Live `main` already enforces the GTGM substrate (squash-only, linear history, composed-tree CI). All docs the contract references exist (`docs/00,01,02,05,07,08,11,13`, `schemas/evidence.schema.json`, `badf/tool-registry.json`, `badf/authority-matrix.json`).
- #122 content is high quality (GIT-I01–I12, GIT-O0–O5 operation classes, the state machine) but carries a temporary lockfile-probe scaffolding test and three id collisions — dropped/fixed in the salvage.

## Unknowns

The later program (WP-GIT-B identity contract … WP-GIT-J activation) is out of scope here. Branch-name enforcement, a Git inspector, and any mutation tooling are deferred to their own failing-first WPs — no mutation script or Git authority in a contract freeze.
